purpose: Teach: カジュアル/リベラル/オールド/エコノミー/ノーマン/ヘルパー/カセット/イレブン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、カジュアル系のブランド着てるな
lines.en: Riku, you wear casual brand stuff, don't you.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Raises it like she's caught him in something small and harmless. Quick cadence, knowing smile underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でリベラル派の主張調べてたな、桜
lines.en: You were looking up what liberals say about society, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle counter-observation. Playful deflection—turning her own game back on her. Slight warmth under the wryness, like he's enjoyed being noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、オールドジャンクの自転車修理してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were fixing up that old junky bike, weren't you.
lines.style: Slight edge of amusement. Drawing out the observation, inviting him to own something he probably tried to hide. Relaxed rhythm, almost affectionate mockery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行のエコノミークラス窮屈だったろ、桜
lines.en: The economy class on the school trip was cramped for you, wasn't it, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection with a hint of sympathy underneath. Catches her fussing over something trivial about him with something equally trivial about her. Matter-of-fact, no gloating.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ノーマン・ベイツのホラー観てたな
lines.en: Riku, you were watching that Norman Bates horror movie, weren't you.
lines.style: Playful jab. Knowing he's embarrassed by it. Light attack on the opening, sustained teasing through the middle, slight lift at the end like she's enjoyed finding him out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祖母ちゃんのヘルパーさんと挨拶してたな、桜
lines.en: You were saying hello to your grandmother's helper, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft catch. Not mean—just noticing something small and genuine that she was doing. Quiet satisfaction in having observed her. Warm underneath the deflection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家にカセットデッキあるって自慢してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were bragging about having a cassette deck at home, weren't you.
lines.style: Amused, affectionate mockery. Slight snort of laughter on the word 'bragging'. She's charmed by the oddness of it, not dismissing him. Quick, light delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サッカー部のイレブンに選ばれたろ、桜
lines.en: You got picked for the soccer team's starting eleven, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine admiration breaking through. Soft but certain. No distance—he's proud of her and letting it show. Straightforward delivery, warm and close.
